bio.text: Melissa Minor-Brown has represented the 17th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2018 and serves as Speaker of the House.
Minor-Brown is a registered nurse with a master's degree in Executive Leadership from Wilmington University, and previously worked for seven years at the Veterans Administration Hospital in Elsmere.
Minor-Brown serves as Region III Chair of the National Black Caucus of State Legislators.
